title: Catalogue
description:
The catalogue returned by `clapham.describe`.

Listing returns an array of descriptors. A named lookup returns one descriptor.

anyOf.description: Every admitted descriptor in the caller's selection, in name order.
The admitted descriptor requested by name.

Category.description: The fixed categories front ends act on when an operation refuses a call.

oneOf.description: The input failed its schema or the operation's checks.
What the input names is absent.
A fence or state conflict prevents the change.
A gate, policy or approval said no.
A required workspace, daemon or remote is unavailable.
The call was cancelled, timed out or stopped by shutdown.
A fault, including an undeclared refusal code.

Effect.description: What an operation does to its environment, declared independently of transport.

oneOf.description: Changes state within the operation's domain.
Changes the host's own administrative state.
Runs against the workspace under its lock.

Operation.description:
An operation's language-neutral descriptor.

Omitting `principals` admits the effect's default kinds. An explicit empty list
admits no kinds. The remaining MCP hints, `idempotent` and `open_world`, are
required rather than silently defaulted. Composition compiles the schemas and
checks the descriptor's cross-field semantics before calls can run.

description.description: What the operation does; this field is required.

effect.description: What the operation does to its environment.

idempotent.description: The declared MCP idempotency hint; queries always map to true.

input.description: The input JSON Schema, explicitly declaring `type: object` at its root.

name.description: The operation's identity, split into namespace and local name at the first dot.

output.description: The result JSON Schema, where supplied; object and boolean schemas are admitted.

positional.description: Input properties taken as positional command-line arguments, in order.

preview.description: Whether the operation accepts a dry run.

principals.description: The kinds admitted; when omitted, defaults from `effect`.

refusals.description: Each declared refusal code and the category front ends act on.

resource.description: A query's resource URI template, where supplied.

streams.description: Whether typed records precede the result.

title.description: The name people read, where supplied.

PrincipalKind.description: The kind of caller running an operation.

oneOf.description: An agent acting under the host's authority.
A service authenticated by the host.
